tasks.label: 1. Build Superloop (Lab 02)
tasks.command: source ~/zephyrproject/zephyr/zephyr-env.sh 2>/dev/null || source ~/.zephyrrc 2>/dev/null || true; west build -p auto -b nucleo_l476rg firmware/superloop

tasks.label: 2. Flash Board (OpenOCD)
tasks.command: source ~/zephyrproject/zephyr/zephyr-env.sh 2>/dev/null || source ~/.zephyrrc 2>/dev/null || true; west flash -r openocd

tasks.label: 4. Build + Flash + Monitor (Full Pipeline)
tasks.command: source ~/zephyrproject/zephyr/zephyr-env.sh 2>/dev/null || source ~/.zephyrrc 2>/dev/null || true; west build -p auto -b nucleo_l476rg firmware/superloop && west flash -r openocd && tio /dev/ttyACM0 -b 115200
